about: Sounds shipped in template/sfx, generated with the ElevenLabs sound-effects and music APIs for the WiFi-lag short. Regenerate with: node tools/cli.mjs regen-sfx [--force] (needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY). 'starts' = where the sound actually begins inside the file (measured), so cues can sit on the exact frame.
